turns.answer:
To run an electric heated blanket all night (8–10 hours), I'd recommend a portable power station with at least 700–1,000Wh of battery capacity.

The right size depends on your blanket's wattage and heat setting. Many electric blankets draw 60–150W at full power, but their average consumption may be lower as the thermostat cycles.

My recommendation: A 1,000Wh-class LiFePO4 power station is a good starting point for overnight heating, especially if you don't know the blanket's actual power consumption.

One important safety note: check that your electric blanket is approved for overnight use and follow its auto-shutoff instructions. Keep the power station uncovered and ventilated.

Two questions so I can recommend the smallest, cheapest station that will work:

Are you using the blanket inside a house, car, or tent?

What is your blanket's wattage (or brand/model)? If you don't know, is it a throw blanket, twin, queen, or king?
